_comment: Which reviewers must sign off before an artifact reaches the decider. Single source of truth: the review and contract skills read it. Reviewer names are plugin agents (review-board:<name>), project agents (.claude/agents/<name>.md), or skills.
rule: Every artifact that needs a sign-off runs its required reviewers BEFORE it reaches the decider, and is presented WITH the named votes attached, never instead of them.

artifacts.trigger: any label, prompt, helper text, button, banner, error, empty state, aria string, or coaching line

any change a user can SEE or OPERATE: a new or edited component, layout, interaction, a visual signal (border, color, icon, badge), a button label, or a state (empty, loading, error, toggle, back button)
artifacts.notes: Trigger on user-facing SURFACE, not on the word 'feature'. The recurring bites are small edits to existing surfaces. The only exemption is provably-no-surface work, attested inline with // REFACTOR_ONLY: <reason>.

artifacts.trigger: any Communication Contract for a new feature or a significant UI change
any multi-screen sequence, signup-to-activated path, handoff between two people, or empty state that waits on someone else
a question, answer set, rubric, scale, classifier label, or any number that reaches a person as a judgment about them or their work
schema, migration, infrastructure, secrets, auth, PII, anything irreversible in production
sequencing, pricing, channel, go-to-market, or build-vs-pass decisions
anything the founder or a partner will read as if it came from them: emails, decision memos, marketing pages, product write-ups
anything a recruiter, customer, reviewer, buyer, or regulator will receive and judge

recurring_bite_categories: button-label and commit-verb changes on existing surfaces ('Complete' shown at 20% progress)
visual signals with no text (a border, color, icon, or badge with no label explaining it)
state transitions (a toggle that toggles nothing visible, a missing empty state, back-button behavior)
